profile.description: Slicker is the AI payment recovery platform for subscription businesses. Failed recurring payments cause involuntary churn that costs subscription companies up to 9% of revenue. Slicker recovers that revenue automatically with two engines: Smart Retries, an ensemble of machine learning models that decides whether, when, and how to retry each failed payment (timing, gateway routing, payment method selection), and hyper-personalized dunning emails sent from the merchant's own domain, tailored to the failure reason and sent only when customer action is the sole path to recovery. Setup takes under 5 minutes on top of existing billing infrastructure (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, Chargebee, Recurly, Zuora and more), with zero engineering lift. We prove ROI with clinical-grade AABB testing and charge purely on performance: if we don't outperform your current setup with statistical significance, you don't pay. Backed by Y Combinator.
